reviewScope: Source review and seven focused CPU tests; no renderer execution or active-job changes by reviewer.

findings.cause: Polling could read RUNNING, observe the exited worker after its COMPLETED write, then overwrite terminal success as INTERRUPTED.
findings.resolution: Root added a private job lock and re-read of the latest state before interruption. Terminal COMPLETED, FAILED and INTERRUPTED states are preserved.

findings.cause: Playwright launches Chromium with detached:true on Unix. Killing only the Node process group cannot guarantee cleanup of a browser in its own group after a hard timeout or failed close. Installed Playwright coreBundle.js:8902-8905 confirms this process launch behavior.
findings.resolution: New process_guard.py observes only verified same-UID descendants, pins each process by Linux pidfd, and cleans detached sessions by process identity. Root must wire it around the child wait after the active capture finishes.
findings.api: with DescendantGuard(child.pid) as guard: ... child.wait(...); finally: cleanup = guard.cleanup()

verification.syntheticProcesses: Only free Python sleep processes, including a detached grandchild and an unrelated same-UID control.

findings.limits: Polling is not cgroup containment. A child that forks and reparents entirely between observations cannot be inferred safely; the guard intentionally never kills unverified orphans. Cleanup reports remaining identities and observation errors.

findings.evidence: studio_service loads the existing production Studio HTTP/auth/Origin/CSRF server with local_test_only=True, loopback host, and the new controller extending the latest ASTRA director. Mobile client uses Android Chromium emulation and the existing login/preflight/submit/start routes.
findings.requiredReporting: This can prove an authenticated Studio source execution path, not deployed gCube HTTPS bootstrap, an updated OCI image, a physical Android device or actual NVIDIA execution. The prior image digest is metadata only. No GPU operator policy is fabricated or bypassed: the opt-in branch is software-only and production calls delegate unchanged.

rootFollowup.details: DescendantGuard wraps the Node child wait; cleanup receipt private; observation errors/remaining descendants fail closed. Five-second deadline cleanup reserve. No unrelated renderer re-run. Focused 50 Python + 14 capture + 15 layout tests pass.
